newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nuevo Leon, Mexico reports foreign investment surge.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Leon, Mexico reports foreign investment surge.

text.p: The northern Mexican state and industrial powerhouse of Nuevo Leon drew in $1 billion in foreign investment in 1996, a state government spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.
"In 1996, 11,000 jobs were created and $1 billion in foreign investment flowed into the state, or 22 percent more than in 1995," said state foreign investment director Omar Cruz.
Nuevo Leon's two-pronged strategy for attracting foreign businesses consisted of heavy investment in education and infrastructure, Cruz added.
"For foreign companies, our strategy is aimed at medium and high-technology firms, to invite companies that can use Mexican inputs and non-polluting factories," he said.
